ITEM 1 | Shredded light-brown/white potato-like strands, pale ivory with golden-brown edges, matted into a loose mound with fine stringy texture, some darker crisp brown bits and flecks scattered through, dry-looking surface with slight sheen, spread about 9 cm by 8 cm and roughly 2 cm high, sitting left of the eggs on the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs, bright yellow with lighter pale patches, soft curds in clumps about 1-3 cm, moist and slightly glossy, irregular folded edges, no visible browning, spread about 10 cm by 8 cm and roughly 2 cm high, sitting right of the shredded item | 130
ITEM 3 | Small loose pieces of scrambled egg, yellow, soft and crumbly, about 2 cm across, sitting separately below the eggs on the plate | 8
